role: The paywall screen (launch gate or from Settings/More) offering the 30-day free trial and the one-time unlock, restore, legal links and data export/deletion; plus PurchaseStatusView, the Settings row showing Owned or a link to the paywall.
types: PaywallView: struct (View) — paywall UI; isGate true when presented as the launch fullScreenCover (EmuquApp.swift:352), false from Settings (PaywallView.swift:686) and More (MoreMenuView.swift:78)
toplevel: Two #Preview blocks (lines 719-731) build PaywallView and PurchaseStatusView with AppDependencies.current.services.storeKitManager injected; preview-only. The `skipDebugButton` body is wrapped in #if DEBUG (lines 355-363), so release builds render nothing there.

flags.text: Only one default-state snapshot (ChartScreenSnapshotTests.swift:157) and three UI tests (privacy button, features, restore button) touch PaywallView; no test drives its per-offer mapping (trialAndUnlock/unlockOnly/unlocked buttons, trialHasEnded caption, retry button). docs/MAINTAINERS.md:903 credits EntitlementAnchorTests with the paywall's logic, while the offer logic is in PaywallGatePolicyTests.

units.does: Computes the PaywallOffer (.trialAndUnlock/.unlockOnly/.unlocked) from storeKit.hasPurchasedProduct and PaywallGatePolicy.canStartTrial(storeKit.hasTrialTransaction, StoreKitManager.hasTrialStarted, storeKit.hasPermanentAccess).

No swipe-dismiss control: the launch gate is a full-screen cover and Settings/More push it, so the gated user leaves through continueWithAccessButton.
